items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: there was Noon on the bazooka plus McNeil Bro and a guitar player

ctx.x: but I think I think there was Noon on the bazooka plus McNeil Bro and a guitar player I don't recall and it was a small partially outside bar under a fairly good sized awning and it was very pleasant to listen to and they played some good music
